summary:
Iter87 — Backend + frontend verification of the 6-part update. BACKEND (6/6 PASS via pytest test_iter87_brands_dealer.py): POST /api/dealers auto-adds a matching /api/brands entry (idempotent for duplicates), PUT /api/brands/{id} renames a brand, PUT rejects duplicate name (400, incl. case-insensitive), PUT 404 for unknown id, PUT 400 for empty/whitespace name. FRONTEND: (2) Vault→Organization→Brands (testID more-brands) routes to /manage/brands; add (manage-name-input+manage-add-btn), edit/rename (edit-<id>+edit-input-<id>+save-<id>) and delete (del-<id>) all round-trip cleanly against /api/brands. (3) Creating a dealer via /api/dealers auto-adds the dealer name to /api/brands (list confirmed). (4) Inventory list on ryan@ryan.com renders a horizontal location bar with 'locbar-all' + one 'locbar-<id>' per top-level location (verified 3 top-levels: '_rtest_loc', 'Home Toolbox', 'Main Toolbox'); tapping ALL keeps 15 cards visible (unfiltered), tapping a chip filters correctly (Home Toolbox → 3 cards, i.e. Home Toolbox itself + its Drawer 1 descendant items); tapping the same active chip again clears it; tapping ALL also clears. (5) Inventory rows show the full location hierarchy path with the '›' separator — 14 of 15 cards contain '›' (e.g. 'Home Toolbox › Drawer 1', 'Main Toolbox › Drawer 1'). (6) Upcoming Features screen renders 1 accordion with header 'Build 3.1.6 · July 2026 · Test · Planned / 3 updates' and toggle works (2nd tap collapses to 'Build 3.1.6 / 3 updates'). Deprecated packages detected: NONE new this round.

ISSUES FOUND: (H1) TOOL-DETAIL HEADER DOES NOT SHOW FULL PATH — the detail header subtitle for the first inventory item shows only 'DRAWER 1' instead of the required 'Home Toolbox › Drawer 1'. Root cause identified in tool/[id].tsx L247-251: allLocations is loaded lazily ONLY when the location picker modal opens (or when startEdit() runs), so on initial mount allLocations = [] and buildLocationPathMap returns undefined for tool.location_id, falling back to tool.location_name (leaf only). Spec explicitly requires the full path on the detail header. (L1) First-tap on a locbar chip after screen mount does NOT apply the filter (cards stay at 15 and the tapped chip does not turn active); the 2nd tap toggles correctly. Same class of first-tap race as the accordion issue reported in iter86 (React Native Web pointer race on first paint). Non-blocking, but worth investigating.

ui_bugs.issue: Detail-screen subtitle does not show full location path 'Parent › Child' on initial mount. Shows just the leaf ('DRAWER 1') because allLocations is only fetched lazily when the location picker or edit mode opens (useEffect at L247-251 is gated on showLocationPicker). Fix: also fetch api.listLocations() on mount (or hoist into the mount-time load alongside the tool fetch). Reference: /app/frontend/app/tool/[id].tsx:246-251, 2599-2602.

First tap on locbar-<id> chip after inventory screen mount is a no-op — cards count doesn't change and the chip doesn't become active. 2nd tap toggles correctly. Suspected React Native Web synthetic-event race on first paint; same symptom as iter86 accordion first-tap. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/inventory.tsx:1079-1094.

design_issues.screen: tool detail (steel skin) on web preview
issues: Screenshot rendered mostly BLACK on web preview under Steel skin — known artifact from iter86 (skinned screens on web); does not affect DOM/functional verification. Switched to 'plain' skin via localStorage to inspect layout — layout is correct on plain.

action_items: Fix tool/[id].tsx: fetch api.listLocations() on tool-detail MOUNT (not just when the picker/edit opens) so the IndustrialBanner subtitle can render the full hierarchy path via buildLocationPathMap(allLocations,' › '). Quick fix: add a useEffect that runs once on load and populates allLocations, or reuse the /api/locations call that other screens already make in a context.
OPTIONAL (low): Investigate first-tap no-op on locbar chips (same class as iter86 accordion first-tap). Likely fixable by pre-priming the font-warmer overlay pointer-events on mount.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes_taxonomy.py _ensure_brand_saved is case-insensitive and idempotent — good. PUT /api/brands/{id} correctly rejects duplicate names via case-insensitive regex + $ne on id. Empty/whitespace name is 400. 404 on missing id.

backend/routes_dealers.py create_dealer calls _ensure_brand_saved(d.name) after insert — no error path if brand insert fails (silent). Not a bug since brand insert is best-effort, but worth a try/except log.

frontend/manage/[kind].tsx is well-structured for the new 'brands' kind (KIND type union includes it, fetcher map includes brand endpoints, icon uses 'ribbon'). testIDs manage-name-input / manage-add-btn / row-<id> / edit-<id> / edit-input-<id> / save-<id> / cancel-<id> / del-<id> all present.

frontend/(tabs)/inventory.tsx L361 uses useMemo to build the path map once per render — OK. But note the map is rebuilt on every render because the useMemo dep is allLocations (fine). Also topLocations sorted alphabetically — matches design.
frontend/tool/[id].tsx L247 useEffect gate on showLocationPicker is the root cause of the subtitle-only-leaf bug. Suggest making the fetch unconditional on mount.
src/locationTree.ts buildLocationPathMap has cycle guard (guard>30) — good.

success_rate.frontend: 5/6 features fully verified — item (5) partially failing: rows OK, detail header NOT showing full path

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral only — created a ZZUI_<ts> brand via UI, renamed to ZZUI_<ts>_R, then deleted. Created & deleted a ZZDLR_<ts> dealer + its auto-brand via API. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ryan@ryan.com has 15 items across 3 top-level locations (_rtest_loc/Home Toolbox/Main Toolbox) — ideal for locbar filter tests. Login is rate-limited (5/min/IP); use fetch('/api/auth/login')+inject token to bypass. WhatsNew modal is gated by tbv_whatsnew_seen_<APP_VERSION> localStorage key — set for '3.1.6' to skip. Steel skin renders BLACK on web; use localStorage tt.skin='plain' before load. Inventory rows use testID 'tool-card-<id>' NOT tool-row-. Direct URL navigation to /inventory or /upcoming-features works reliably; clicking the bottom tab-<name> button sometimes doesn't switch tabs when WhatsNew was recently visible.
rca_of_issue: H1 tool-detail header missing full path — RCA: /app/frontend/app/tool/[id].tsx line 247-251 gates the api.listLocations() call on showLocationPicker being true. On initial detail-screen mount, allLocations is empty. buildLocationPathMap(allLocations,' › ')[tool.location_id] therefore returns undefined, so the || fallback renders tool.location_name (the leaf name only). Reproduction: log in as ryan@ryan.com → Inventory → tap 'Blue Shop Towels (200 ct)' → banner subtitle shows 'DRAWER 1' (expected 'Home Toolbox › Drawer 1'). Mitigation: convert the effect to run once on mount OR always: useEffect(() => { api.listLocations().then(setAllLocations).catch(()=>{}); }, []).
